title: Condensing Graphs via One-Step Gradient Matching
gpu_scope: PyTorch CUDA optimization when the device is configured; preprocessing and evaluation orchestration may use CPU.
notes: GPU graph condensation implementation. GraphSlim adapts one-step gradient matching to its node-learning pipeline; this is not a claim of reproducing every original graph-classification experiment. Synthetic graph utility must be measured under a fixed train/validation/test protocol. GraphSlim CPU sparsification routines are not GPU spectral sparsifiers.
